metadata-extraction.quality_boundary: Preserve supplied source IDs, unknowns and exact field values.

format-conversion.quality_boundary: Preserve facts, citations, numbers and uncertainty.

screening-assist.quality_boundary: Preserve screening reasons and source locators; missing evidence stays unknown.

evidence-synthesis.quality_boundary: Source-bound internal synthesis; retain conflicts, exact evidence locators and unknowns. No automatic claim acceptance.

scientific-judgment.quality_boundary: Use source evidence and state uncertainty; a model opinion is not experimental validation.

independent-critique.quality_boundary: Review the supplied evidence freshly; identify findings and uncertainty.

reader-translation.quality_boundary: Faithful personal-reading translation preserving source pages, numbers, citations and uncertainty; not verified citation evidence.

reader-qa.quality_boundary: Personal source-bound reading answers with exact supplied page locators. Abstain for missing material; never convert an internal answer into verified citation evidence.

engineering-diagnosis.quality_boundary: Diagnose supplied logs and code; verify proposed repairs through relevant checks.

engineering-code-review.quality_boundary: Identify source locations and verification steps for implementation findings.

engineering-test-design.quality_boundary: Design software regression and boundary tests for the requested behavior.

engineering-reproducibility.quality_boundary: Inspect environment, dependencies and run logs; preserve actual inputs and failures.

multimodal-inspection.quality_boundary: Inspect supplied image or PDF evidence; do not infer observations absent from the source.
